Subject: Next steps after demo: SOC 2 Type II report, interim attestation & portal access for EmberHealth

Hi Ava / Rajesh,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions from the security and infra teams. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we can keep the procurement track moving: 

- Deliverables you requested: SOC 2 Type II report (latest period), interim attestation/bridge letter, and program artifacts via our TrustLocker portal.
- Questions you raised: HIPAA scoping for Protected Health Information (we support HIPAA-covered workloads with private deployment options), GDPR/data residency options (we have EU regions and can discuss DPA clauses).
- Action items (owner / ETA):
  1) Redwood to request portal access for EmberHealth (Ava/Rajesh to confirm users) — Rachel/Grace — by 5/22
  2) Redwood to provide interim attestation while final Type II report is being packaged — Grace — by 5/21
  3) EmberHealth to share completed vendor security questionnaire / preferred evidence upload format — Ava — by 5/23

I attached a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx that maps the items above to owners and dates. If you can confirm the people we should invite to TrustLocker (suggested: ava.collins@emberhealth.com, r.patel@emberhealth.com, security@emberhealth.com) I’ll kick off the portal invite and we’ll send the interim attestation PDF right after.

If anything here looks off, call it out and I’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll proceed with the portal invite and evidence package.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our internal notes. We’d like the following items clarified before we accept the portal invite: 

1) Can you confirm whether the interim attestation will explicitly state support for HIPAA (BAA scope)? Our legal/security folks need a line item to confirm Redwood's responsibilities for PHI.
2) For GDPR: do you have a standard DPA we can review, and do you support EU data residency (we’d prefer EU hosting for EU patients)?
3) For the vendor questionnaire: we can either upload your requested artifacts or provide the completed vendor security questionnaire (XLS). Which format is preferred?

We’ll confirm the portal invite list — please add the three addresses below:
- ava.collins@emberhealth.com
- r.patel@emberhealth.com
- j.santos@emberhealth.com (security manager)

Thanks — aim to get you the vendor questionnaire by Friday.

Best,
Ava
Head of Security Operations | EmberHealth
ava.collins@emberhealth.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo: SOC 2 Type II report, interim attestation & portal access for EmberHealth

Hi Ava — nice to meet you over email. I'm Grace, one of the security engineers supporting this account. Quick answers: 

- Interim attestation: yes, we will provide an interim_attestation_redwood_2025-05.pdf that includes a HIPAA/BAA statement where applicable. That document is not the full Type II report but should be sufficient for procurement to move forward while we arrange access to the full report.
- DPA & data residency: we have a standard DPA we can share (happy to redline). We operate EU regions for customers that require EU residency — Rachel, we should flag this in the MAM if EmberHealth asks for EU-only hosting.
- Evidence upload format: TrustLocker accepts XLS/PDF/ZIP. If EmberHealth prefers to upload a completed questionnaire, recommend PDF export of the XLS to keep evidence links stable.

I will: 
- Upload the interim attestation to TrustLocker and initiate the invite for the emails Rachel listed.
- Upload a SOC 2 checklist (soc2-request-checklist.pdf) that maps commonly requested artifacts to file names — that should speed your intake.

Please expect an invite from trustlocker@redwood.ai; if your team needs specific SSO config or IP allowlisting let us know and we’ll coordinate with infra.

---
Grace O'Connor
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Thanks Grace — we received the invite and I confirmed with our security manager. We see an invite pending from trustlocker@redwood.ai and have access to the soc2-request-checklist.pdf you uploaded. Two quick notes: 

1) For the HIPAA line in the interim attestation, can you include the specific controls we should cite for our BA assessment (e.g., access controls, encryption at rest/transit, audit logs)? That will save another round of back-and-forth.
2) We'll upload the completed XLS questionnaire as a PDF by EOD Friday.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — this helps the legal team move the SOW/PO faster.

Regards,
Rajesh Patel
VP, Infrastructure | EmberHealth
